author: a. j. zhao
title: University of Hawai'i sailing team finishes sixth at PCCSC Team Race Championship - Maui Reporter
text:
The University of Hawai’i coed sailing team finished sixth at the Pacific Coast Collegiate Sailing Conference (PCCSC) Team Race Championship, which took place on April 4 and 5 in Redwood City, California.
The event marked the start of postseason competition for the Rainbow Sailors. Nine schools from the conference competed in a single round-robin format, with each school participating in eight three-on-three matchups. The top four teams advanced to a two-round championship series, where host Stanford won all its races and claimed the title.
Hawai’i had placed second in last year’s championship but ended this year’s event with a record of three wins and five losses. The team’s victories came against USC, UC Santa Cruz, and UC Berkeley. Four pairs represented Hawai’i: Erik Anderson with Amanda Turner; Everett McAvoy with Alister Muto; Stella Taherian with Martha Schuessler; and Spencer Fleming with Leila Landay.
Looking ahead, the Rainbow Sailors plan to compete next at the PCCSC Fleet Race Championship in Long Beach, California on April 18-19. There they will aim for a berth into the Inter-Collegiate Sailing Association National Championship.
